name: Brookview Elementary
address: 8000 EP True Parkway, West Des Moines, IA 50266
principalBio: Welcome to Brookview! My name is Derek Barnhouse, and I am honored to serve as principal at Brookview Elementary. Previously, I was the assistant principal at Brookview, along with a second and fourth grade teacher here in the Waukee Community School District. I completed my undergraduate degree at Luther College and my master’s degree in school administration at Drake University. Outside of school, I enjoy spending time with my wife and our two young children. Students, and the positive relationships we hope to build with them and their families, are at the heart of our work here at Brookview. We believe in the leadership of all students and the importance of making a positive impact on the world around us. Thank you for being a part of the Brookview community.

At Eason, we strive to meet our district’s vision of inspiring learners who feel valued, challenged, and prepared to embrace tomorrow’s opportunities. I have served as the Eason principal since 2015. Previously, I served as an assistant principal, fifth grade teacher, and fourth grade teacher. I enjoy working and living in Waukee. My wife is a first grade teacher in Waukee, and we are the proud parents of four kids who have all attended school in the Waukee Community School District. Thank you for being part of our Eason community, and I look forward to partnering with you this year!

name: Grant Ragan Elementary
principalBio: I am fortunate to serve students and staff as the principal of Grant Ragan Elementary. I’m proud to work alongside talented teachers as we work towards Waukee’s vision, inspiring learners who feel valued, challenged, and prepared to embrace tomorrow’s opportunities. I received my B.A. in elementary education from the University of Northern Iowa in 1999, an M.S. in education from Michigan State University in 2005, and an M.Ed. in educational administration from Iowa State University in 2015. I hold teaching endorsements in kindergarten through sixth grade elementary teaching, kindergarten through twelfth grade talented and gifted, kindergarten through eighth grade reading, and kindergarten through eighth grade science. I have served as the Grant Ragan principal since 2017. Previously, I served as an assistant principal, instructional coach, ELP teacher, and elementary classroom teacher. I am also a past president of the Iowa Talented and Gifted Association (ITAG). My wife Jann is a physical therapist in Ames, and we are the proud parents of three sons, Luke, Nicholas, and Jack.

name: Maple Grove Elementary
principalBio: My name is Graham Jones, and I have the honor of serving as building principal at Maple Grove Elementary. We encourage our students and staff to be lifelong learners, and I have been fortunate to have many opportunities to pursue many educational opportunities. I earned my teaching degree at the University of Northern Iowa with a BA in Elementary Education. I began my teaching career in West Des Moines prior to earning my Master’s Degree at Iowa State University with an emphasis in Educational Leadership in 2009. I then served as an assistant principal and building principal for fourteen years in the West Des Moines Community School District. In 2017, I completed my studies with a doctorate degree at Drake University. In 2022, I joined the Maple Grove team and have enjoyed collaborating with an amazing group of staff, students, and families! When I’m not spending time with my Maple Grove family, I am busy being a husband and father. My wife, Jenni, and I have four children who keep us busy with activities and life! Thank you for being part of our Maple Grove community and we look forward to partnering with you this year!

name: Radiant Elementary
principalBio: I moved to the United States from Bosnia when I was six years old and began kindergarten in Des Moines without speaking any English, a perspective that continues to shape me as a school leader. I am passionate about building strong, inclusive communities where students, families, and staff feel a deep sense of belonging and purpose. Outside of school, I love spending time with my family and young daughter, traveling, reading on a sunny patio, and enjoying coffee with loved ones. I previously worked as a photographer specializing in weddings, families, and senior portraits. I’m most excited about the human connections we’ll build at Radiant. I will lead with compassion, collaboration, and an unwavering commitment to doing what’s right for kids.

name: Shuler Elementary
principalBio: Welcome to Shuler Elementary School! I am Dr. Ryan Marzen, and I feel incredibly lucky to be the principal of a fantastic staff and community. Before joining Shuler, I earned a Bachelor’s (B.A.) in elementary education and history from Buena Vista University in 2012. In the fall of 2012, I started my career teaching first grade and coaching at Denison Community School District. During that time, I earned a Master’s in Education (M.Ed.) in educational administration from South Dakota State University. In 2017, I began serving as Associate Principal at Perry Elementary School and moved into the principal position in 2021. Shortly after, I earned my Doctorate (Ed.D.) in Educational Leadership from Drake University. My wife, Jennifer, a previous professional school counselor, now takes care of our children, Ezekiel, Elijah, and Sophia, as a stay-at-home mom. We are excited to partner with your child(ren) as they… Dream. Wonder. Shine.

name: Sugar Creek Elementary
principalBio: My name is Liz Griesel, and I’m proud to serve the students and staff as the Principal of Sugar Creek Elementary. At Sugar Creek, we strive to meet our District’s mission of focusing on the joy of learning and growth for everyone through innovative educational experiences, optimizing individual learning, and creating potential for success in a global community. I joined the Waukee School District in 2018, as an assistant principal at Eason and Maple Grove Elementary Schools. In 2022, I had the opportunity to open Waukee’s tenth elementary school, Sugar Creek, as our principal. Previous to joining the Waukee CSD family, I served as a curriculum coordinator, instructional coach, and middle school teacher in Des Moines Public Schools. I completed my Bachelor’s and Master’s degrees at Drake University and my Ph.D. at Iowa State University. I enjoy working and living in our District. My husband owns a landscaping business, and our three kids attend school in the District. We take great pride in our community and are grateful for the many opportunities and friendships that we have here!

name: Walnut Hills Elementary
principalBio: Welcome to Walnut Hills! My name is Doug Barry, and I feel so privileged to serve as Principal here! I earned my teaching degree at the University of Northern Iowa and spent a year at the University of Oregon during this time. While teaching in North Kansas City, I earned my master’s in Educational Leadership from the University of Missouri – Kansas City. Over the past thirteen years, I served as the principal at both Maple Grove and South Middle School and the assistant principal between Maple Grove and Eason. When I’m not at school, I enjoy spending time with my wife and three sons. We love to be outside, travel, play disc golf, golf, or pickleball, and cheer on our favorite teams: Oregon Ducks, Northern Iowa Panthers, and the Philadelphia Eagles. I feel so fortunate to be able to serve the Walnut Hills community this year and be able to work alongside an amazing group of students, teachers, and parents throughout the entire Waukee School District!

name: Waterford Elementary
principalBio: Welcome to Waterford! My name is Joel Fey, and I have the privilege of serving as the principal at Waterford Elementary. At Waterford, we strive to be Respectful and Responsible, Inclusive, Safe, and Empathetic. We believe every student can lead with heart, character, and above all, empathy—showing kindness, understanding, and care in all we do. #RiseUpWaterford I earned my BA in Elementary Education from Grand View College and spent eleven years in the classroom before completing my Master’s Degree in Educational Leadership at Drake University. I served as an administrator in Nevada, Iowa, for ten years, then joined Waukee in 2017 as principal of Shuler Elementary. I am now proud to lead at Waterford. In 2022, I completed my Doctorate at Drake University. Outside of school, I enjoy spending time with my family, especially in my favorite new role—being a grandpa! Thank you for being part of our Waterford family. I look forward to partnering with you this year.

name: Waukee Elementary
principalBio: Welcome to Waukee Elementary! I feel very fortunate to work with such amazing teachers, students, and parents! After graduating from the University of Northern Iowa, I began my education career right here in the Waukee Community School District in 2002. I taught for a total of four years, first at Waukee Elementary and then at Walnut Hills Elementary. I received my MSE in Education Leadership from Drake University in 2006. I then served as the assistant principal at both Waukee Elementary and Walnut Hills Elementary for two years before becoming the principal at Waukee Elementary in 2008. I completed my EdS in Educational Administration at Drake University in 2014 and continue to enjoy my role at Waukee Elementary! Living and working in the District gives me a great sense of pride. My husband also works for Waukee CSD, and we are very thankful to be part of this great community. All of our four children have also been a part of the Waukee Community School District.

principalBio: Welcome to Woodland Hills! We’re so excited that you are part of our school family and about partnering with you in your child’s education! My name is Scott Shumaker, and I am fortunate to serve as the Principal of Woodland Hills Elementary since 2013. Previously, I was an assistant principal and classroom teacher right here in the Waukee Community School District. I believe it is the relationships formed and collaboration between the students, families, and staff that make a building special. Making Connections + Growing Leaders is our building motto, and the Woodland Hills Team is dedicated to providing quality education and a caring environment. We value relationships and look forward to getting to know you and your child(ren) as members of our Woodland Hills Family!

principalBio: I’ve been in education for more than two decades! The vast majority of which has been at the middle school level. Most recently, I’ve served as an administrator in Waukee, working at Waukee Middle School, Trailridge, and Timberline. I have three children in the Waukee School District, and I can’t be prouder of the education they’ve received. I firmly believe that all of us are very lucky to be part of this community, given the passion of our teachers and staff, and the commitment to a quality education that’s supported by our families and community. I’m looking forward to continuing to serve our community in this new school!

address: 2350 SE LA Grant Parkway, Waukee, IA 50263
principalBio: On behalf of our amazing staff, welcome to South Middle School! My name is Joe, and I am honored to serve as the principal. I grew up in Minnesota and graduated from Totino-Grace High School in 2001. I came to Iowa by attending Drake University for my bachelor’s degree. I have continued my formal education by earning my master’s degree from Iowa State University, and my specialist degree and PhD from Drake. I began my education career by teaching high school math at Des Moines Lincoln High School. After working in the Des Moines Public Schools curriculum department for a year, I moved into building administration at three different buildings. I came to Waukee Schools for the 2022-23 school year as the South Middle School principal. My wife and I married in 2011, and we have three school-age children who attend Waukee schools. When not working, I enjoy being with my family, playing and watching sports, performing arts, and traveling. My side hustle is refereeing soccer, and I can also be found coaching just about anything my kids are playing.

name: Timberline Middle School
address: 2605 SE LA Grant Parkway, Waukee, IA 50263
principalBio: On behalf of our amazing staff, welcome to Timberline Middle School! My name is Alex Lancaster, and I’m honored to serve as the principal. I’m a proud Waukee High School graduate and feel incredibly fortunate to now work in the district that helped shape me. I earned my bachelor’s degree in Psychology from Creighton University, then went on to earn a Master’s in Teaching, a Master’s in Educational Leadership, and a Specialist’s degree with Superintendent Licensure from Drake University. I’m currently pursuing my doctorate at Drake as well. I began my career as a middle school math and social studies teacher before moving into building leadership roles, including serving as a seventh through twelfth grade principal and an associate principal at the high school level. I’m passionate about supporting students and staff and excited to help build strong systems and a positive culture here at Timberline. My focus is on creating a culture where every student and staff member feels a strong sense of belonging from day one. My husband, Joe, and I live in Waukee with our three boys, who all attend Waukee Schools. Outside of work, I love spending time with my family, boating, swimming, or finding a good series on Netflix. I’m proud to call this community home and thrilled to be part of Timberline’s journey.

When I am not at school, I enjoy spending time with my husband, Jason, and our four kids, Sydney, Audrey, Jake, and Logan. We love being outside, fishing, attending athletic events, and spending time cheering on the Iowa Hawkeyes! Thank you for partnering with the Waukee Middle School family on this journey in your child’s education. Please do not hesitate to reach out if you have any questions or concerns. I look forward to partnering with you!

name: Prairieview School
principalBio: I am excited to help lead the fantastic team at Prairieview by helping each staff member and student become their best self. I grew up on an acreage near Marshalltown and graduated from Green Mountain-Garwin High School. I earned my bachelor’s degree in Biology from Iowa State University (go Cyclones!). After student teaching in Rome, Italy, I began my education career at Southeast Polk as a science teacher and coach. I continued my passion for teaching and coaching at Johnston High School before moving on to serve as Assistant Principal at Saydel High School, where I eventually had the privilege to become Principal. Since then, I have been honored to serve the Waukee and Timberline community as Assistant Principal. My wife, Kelly, and I met at Iowa State — so it’s no surprise our kids, Quinnlyn and Conor, bleed cardinal and gold. We have a handful of pets, including three rabbits, a bearded dragon, and about 30,000 honeybees. In my free time, I enjoy all things outdoors, especially cycling, and believe RAGBRAI is the most wonderful time of the year.

name: Trailridge School
principalBio: It’s my honor to serve as the Principal at Trailridge, and I look forward to working with students, parents, and staff to create an environment focused on growth! My journey as an educator has allowed me to learn from many amazing people in several different roles. The journey started in Cairo, Egypt, as a student teacher before coming to Central Iowa to teach science at Des Moines Lincoln for ten years and Prairieview for four years. I transitioned to serving as an Instructional Coach at South Middle School and Waukee High School for five years before becoming an administrator. Since then, I’ve served as assistant principal at Timberline, principal at Prairieview, and now principal at Trailridge. It’s great to be back where the Waukee journey began! My wife, Dawn, is a Literacy Interventionist at South Middle School and an online instructor at Simpson College. We enjoy spending time with our children Rudy, Harrison, and Ritchina. In my free time, I enjoy playing the drums in the all-educator band, Faculty Lounge, as well as mountain biking.

name: Northwest High School
principalBio: I am honored to serve our students, families, staff, and community as the principal of Waukee Northwest High School. I am dedicated to building upon our successes and continuing the longstanding Waukee Community School District tradition of excellence in academics, athletics, and fine arts. I have served Waukee Community Schools since 2009 as both a teacher and administrator. Before my time with Waukee Community School District, I was a teacher and head football coach in Atlantic, Iowa. I hold a bachelor’s degree from Drake University and a master’s degree from the University of South Dakota. I reside in the Waukee District with my wife, Natalie, also an educator in Waukee, and our three children. We feel so fortunate to have the opportunity to raise our kids in this community and school district. I look forward to collaborating with our students, families, staff, and community to prepare all students to be successful upon graduation.

name: Waukee High School
principalBio: Greetings from the Waukee High School Principal! My husband, Todd, and I love being a part of this community and chose to raise our family here. Besides working at Waukee CSD, I’ve enjoyed teaching and administrative positions in other schools, including Des Moines East High School, Casady Alternative School, and Abraham Lincoln High School. I have also taught at Drake and Viterbo University. Throughout my career in education, I have consistently championed the importance of relationship-building. I firmly believe that strong, trusting relationships between administrators, teachers, staff, students, parents, and community members are essential for creating a positive and supportive school environment. We can achieve remarkable outcomes by fostering a culture where ideas are freely exchanged, feedback is welcomed, and teamwork is celebrated. Waukee High School continues to excel both inside and outside the classroom. We have opportunities for all our students to grow, learn, and develop the skills to be leaders for our world. We are Waukee! Go, Warriors!

name: Natatorium
principalBio: I have been an athlete, coach, teacher, parent, and administrator in aquatics and swimming. I competed as a swimmer as a young child through college and swam for The University of Kansas. After graduating college, I combined my passion for teaching with swimming and began coaching. Since, I have coached with the YMCA, USA Swimming, high schools, and colleges. My family is a “swimming family.” My wife, Andrea Kelley, works in radiology in mammography. Although she didn’t grow up a competitive swimmer, she has become very involved in the sport since our marriage. She is a swim official and has worked at some of the highest-level swim meets in the country, including the Women’s NCAA Division 1 Championships. She officiates club meets, high school meets, and NCAA meets. She has been an official and the starter at many girls and boys’ High School state meets. I’ve been excited about the Waukee Community School District opportunity since I heard about the new facility. The Waukee Natatorium will be an amazing place for students to learn and enjoy the sport of swimming and diving.

principalBio: I am proud to serve as the Preschool Program Administrator for Waukee Community School District. Before serving Waukee’s youngest learners, I was the building principal at Walnut Hills Elementary, an assistant principal in Waukee, and taught special education for ten years. Growing up in Minnesota, I graduated from Bloomington Jefferson High School. I attended Buena Vista University in Storm Lake, Iowa, where I received my Bachelor’s in Elementary and Special Education. I taught special education in Storm Lake, Shakopee, West Des Moines, and Waukee. After moving back to the Des Moines area, I attended Drake University and received my Master’s in Educational Leadership. I absolutely love working with our early childhood students, families, and staff. Being a part of our young students’ initial journey in school brings me such joy. The staff and families with whom I get to work are incredibly supportive and collaborative, and share my love for early childhood education.
